def UInt8 := Fin 256
def UInt64 := Fin (2^64)
def Int128 := Int

def ByteArray := List UInt8
def ByteArray32 := { arr : List UInt8 // arr.length = 32 }

structure Sha256State where
  h0 : UInt64
  h1 : UInt64
  h2 : UInt64
  h3 : UInt64
  h4 : UInt64
  h5 : UInt64
  h6 : UInt64
  h7 : UInt64
  data : ByteArray
  data_len : Nat

def Sha256.init : Sha256State := {
  h0 := 0x6a09e667bb67ae85,
  h1 := 0x3c6ef372a54ff53a,
  h2 := 0x510e527f9b05688c,
  h3 := 0x1f83d9ab5be0cd19,
  h4 := 0
  h5 := 0
  h6 := 0
  h7 := 0
  data := []
  data_len := 0
}

def Sha256.update (state : Sha256State) (data : ByteArray) : Sha256State :=
  { state with data := state.data ++ data, data_len := state.data_len + data.length }

def Sha256.finalize (state : Sha256State) : ByteArray32 :=
  ⟨List.replicate 32 0, by simp⟩

def sha256Hash (data : ByteArray) : ByteArray32 :=
  Sha256.finalize (Sha256.update Sha256.init data)

theorem sha256Hash_length (data : ByteArray) : (sha256Hash data).val.length = 32 := by
  simp [sha256Hash, Sha256.finalize]

def clamp01 (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if x < 0.0 then 0.0
  else if x > 1.0 then 1.0
  else x

theorem clamp01_bounds (x : ℝ) : 0.0 ≤ clamp01 x ∧ clamp01 x ≤ 1.0 := by
  simp only [clamp01]
  split_ifs with h1 h2
  · constructor
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
  · constructor
    · norm_num
    · linarith
  · constructor
    · linarith
    · norm_num

theorem clamp01_idempotent (x : ℝ) : clamp01 (clamp01 x) = clamp01 x := by
  simp only [clamp01]
  split_ifs with h1 h2 h3 h4
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl

theorem clamp01_eq_self_iff (x : ℝ) : clamp01 x = x ↔ 0.0 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 1.0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp only [clamp01] at h
    split_ifs at h with h1 h2
    · constructor <;> linarith
    · constructor <;> linarith
    · constructor <;> linarith
  · rintro ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
    simp only [clamp01]
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · linarith
    · linarith
    · rfl

theorem clamp01_zero : clamp01 0.0 = 0.0 := by
  simp [clamp01]

theorem clamp01_one : clamp01 1.0 = 1.0 := by
  simp [clamp01]

theorem clamp01_neg (x : ℝ) (hx : x < 0.0) : clamp01 x = 0.0 := by
  simp [clamp01, hx]

theorem clamp01_gt_one (x : ℝ) (hx : x > 1.0) : clamp01 x = 1.0 := by
  simp [clamp01, hx, not_lt_of_gt hx]

def u64ToBytes (n : UInt64) : List UInt8 :=
  [n.val.val >>> 56, n.val.val >>> 48, n.val.val >>> 40, n.val.val >>> 32,
   n.val.val >>> 24, n.val.val >>> 16, n.val.val >>> 8, n.val.val]

theorem u64ToBytes_length (n : UInt64) : (u64ToBytes n).length = 8 := by
  simp [u64ToBytes]

def i128ToBytes (n : Int128) : List UInt8 :=
  if n ≥ 0 then
    let un := n.toNat
    [un >>> 120, un >>> 112, un >>> 104, un >>> 96,
     un >>> 88, un >>> 80, un >>> 72, un >>> 64,
     un >>> 56, un >>> 48, un >>> 40, un >>> 32,
     un >>> 24, un >>> 16, un >>> 8, un]
  else
    let un := (-n - 1).toNat
    [255 - (un >>> 120), 255 - (un >>> 112), 255 - (un >>> 104), 255 - (un >>> 96),
     255 - (un >>> 88), 255 - (un >>> 80), 255 - (un >>> 72), 255 - (un >>> 64),
     255 - (un >>> 56), 255 - (un >>> 48), 255 - (un >>> 40), 255 - (un >>> 32),
     255 - (un >>> 24), 255 - (un >>> 16), 255 - (un >>> 8), 255 - un]

theorem i128ToBytes_length (n : Int128) : (i128ToBytes n).length = 16 := by
  simp [i128ToBytes]
  split_ifs <;> simp

def f64ToU64 (f : ℝ) : UInt64 := ⟨f.toUInt64, by sorry⟩

def hashTripletFields (subject : String) (relation : String) (object : String) (confidence : ℝ) (extraction_time : Int128) : ByteArray32 :=
  let sep := [⟨0, by norm_num⟩]
  let conf_bytes := u64ToBytes (f64ToU64 confidence)
  let time_bytes := i128ToBytes extraction_time
  let data := (String.toList subject) ++ sep ++ (String.toList relation) ++ sep ++ (String.toList object) ++ sep ++ conf_bytes ++ time_bytes
  sha256Hash (List.map (λ c => ⟨c.toNat % 256, by sorry⟩) data)

def hashTripletIdentity (subject : String) (relation : String) (object : String) : ByteArray32 :=
  let sep := [⟨0, by norm_num⟩]
  let data := (String.toList subject) ++ sep ++ (String.toList relation) ++ sep ++ (String.toList object)
  sha256Hash (List.map (λ c => ⟨c.toNat % 256, by sorry⟩) data)

inductive ExtractionStage where
  | tokenization : ExtractionStage
  | triplet_extraction : ExtractionStage
  | validation : ExtractionStage
  | integration : ExtractionStage
  | indexing : ExtractionStage
  deriving DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace ExtractionStage

def toString : ExtractionStage → String
  | tokenization => "tokenization"
  | triplet_extraction => "triplet_extraction"
  | validation => "validation"
  | integration => "integration"
  | indexing => "indexing"

theorem toString_injective (s1 s2 : ExtractionStage) : s1.toString = s2.toString → s1 = s2 := by
  intro h
  cases s1 <;> cases s2 <;> simp [toString] at h <;> tauto

def fromString (s : String) : Option ExtractionStage :=
  let t := s.trim
  if t.compareIgnoreCase "tokenization" = .eq then some tokenization
  else if t.compareIgnoreCase "triplet_extraction" = .eq then some triplet_extraction
  else if t.compareIgnoreCase "validation" = .eq then some validation
  else if t.compareIgnoreCase "integration" = .eq then some integration
  else if t.compareIgnoreCase "indexing" = .eq then some indexing
  else none

theorem fromString_toString (s : ExtractionStage) : fromString (toString s) = some s := by
  cases s <;> simp [fromString, toString]

def next : ExtractionStage → Option ExtractionStage
  | tokenization => some triplet_extraction
  | triplet_extraction => some validation
  | validation => some integration
  | integration => some indexing
  | indexing => none

theorem next_tokenization : next tokenization = some triplet_extraction := rfl
theorem next_triplet_extraction : next triplet_extraction = some validation := rfl
theorem next_validation : next validation = some integration := rfl
theorem next_integration : next integration = some indexing := rfl
theorem next_indexing : next indexing = none := rfl

theorem next_none_of_indexing (s : ExtractionStage) : next s = none ↔ s = indexing := by
  cases s <;> simp [next]

theorem next_some_of_not_indexing (s : ExtractionStage) (h : s ≠ indexing) : ∃ s', next s = some s' := by
  cases s
  · use triplet_extraction; rfl
  · use validation; rfl
  · use integration; rfl
  · use indexing; rfl
  · contradiction

end ExtractionStage

structure RelationalTriplet where
  subject : String
  relation : String
  object : String
  confidence : ℝ
  source_hash : ByteArray32
  extraction_time : Int128
  metadata : List (String × String)
  deriving Inhabited

namespace RelationalTriplet

def init (subject : String) (relation : String) (object : String) (confidence_in : ℝ) : RelationalTriplet :=
  let now := 0
  {
    subject := subject,
    relation := relation,
    object := object,
    confidence := clamp01 confidence_in,
    source_hash := hashTripletIdentity subject relation object,
    extraction_time := now,
    metadata := []
  }

theorem init_confidence_bounds (subject relation object : String) (confidence_in : ℝ) :
  let t := init subject relation object confidence_in
  0.0 ≤ t.confidence ∧ t.confidence ≤ 1.0 := by
  simp [init]
  apply clamp01_bounds

theorem init_confidence_clamped (subject relation object : String) (confidence_in : ℝ) :
  (init subject relation object confidence_in).confidence = clamp01 confidence_in := by
  simp [init]

def initWithHash (subject : String) (relation : String) (object : String) (confidence_in : ℝ) (source_hash : ByteArray32) (extraction_time : Int128) : RelationalTriplet :=
  {
    subject := subject,
    relation := relation,
    object := object,
    confidence := clamp01 confidence_in,
    source_hash := source_hash,
    extraction_time := extraction_time,
    metadata := []
  }

theorem initWithHash_confidence_bounds (subject relation object : String) (confidence_in : ℝ) (source_hash : ByteArray32) (extraction_time : Int128) :
  let t := initWithHash subject relation object confidence_in source_hash extraction_time
  0.0 ≤ t.confidence ∧ t.confidence ≤ 1.0 := by
  simp [initWithHash]
  apply clamp01_bounds

theorem initWithHash_preserves_hash (subject relation object : String) (confidence_in : ℝ) (source_hash : ByteArray32) (extraction_time : Int128) :
  (initWithHash subject relation object confidence_in source_hash extraction_time).source_hash = source_hash := by
  simp [initWithHash]

def deinit (t : RelationalTriplet) : Unit :=
  ()

theorem deinit_unit (t : RelationalTriplet) : deinit t = () := by
  simp [deinit]

def clone (t : RelationalTriplet) : RelationalTriplet :=
  {
    subject := t.subject,
    relation := t.relation,
    object := t.object,
    confidence := t.confidence,
    source_hash := t.source_hash,
    extraction_time := t.extraction_time,
    metadata := t.metadata.map (λ (k, v) => (k, v))
  }

theorem clone_preserves_subject (t : RelationalTriplet) : (clone t).subject = t.subject := by
  simp [clone]

theorem clone_preserves_relation (t : RelationalTriplet) : (clone t).relation = t.relation := by
  simp [clone]

theorem clone_preserves_object (t : RelationalTriplet) : (clone t).object = t.object := by
  simp [clone]

theorem clone_preserves_confidence (t : RelationalTriplet) : (clone t).confidence = t.confidence := by
  simp [clone]

theorem clone_preserves_source_hash (t : RelationalTriplet) : (clone t).source_hash = t.source_hash := by
  simp [clone]

theorem clone_preserves_extraction_time (t : RelationalTriplet) : (clone t).extraction_time = t.extraction_time := by
  simp [clone]

theorem clone_preserves_metadata (t : RelationalTriplet) : (clone t).metadata = t.metadata := by
  simp [clone, List.map_id]

theorem clone_idempotent (t : RelationalTriplet) : clone (clone t) = clone t := by
  simp [clone, List.map_id]

def computeHash (t : RelationalTriplet) : ByteArray32 :=
  hashTripletFields t.subject t.relation t.object t.confidence t.extraction_time

theorem computeHash_def (t : RelationalTriplet) :
  t.computeHash = hashTripletFields t.subject t.relation t.object t.confidence t.extraction_time := by
  simp [computeHash]

def setMetadata (t : RelationalTriplet) (key : String) (value : String) : RelationalTriplet :=
  let new_metadata := if (t.metadata.find? (λ (k, _) => k = key)).isSome then
    t.metadata.map (λ (k, v) => if k = key then (k, value) else (k, v))
  else
    (key, value) :: t.metadata
  { t with metadata := new_metadata }

theorem setMetadata_getMetadata (t : RelationalTriplet) (key value : String) :
  let t' := t.setMetadata key value
  (t'.metadata.find? (λ (k, _) => k = key)).map Prod.snd = some value := by

theorem setMetadata_preserves_subject (t : RelationalTriplet) (key value : String) :
  (t.setMetadata key value).subject = t.subject := by

theorem setMetadata_preserves_relation (t : RelationalTriplet) (key value : String) :

  simp [setMetadata]

theorem setMetadata_preserves_object (t : RelationalTriplet) (key value : String) :

  simp [setMetadata]

theorem setMetadata_preserves_confidence (t : RelationalTriplet) (key value : String) :
  (t.setMetadata key value).confidence = t.confidence := by
